أستنكف (form X)
# أَسْتَنْكِفُ (ʔastankifu) /ʔas.tan.ki.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْكَفَ (istankafa)
# أَسْتَنْكِفَ (ʔastankifa) /ʔas.tan.ki.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَنْكَفَ (istankafa)
# أَسْتَنْكِفْ (ʔastankif) /ʔas.tan.kif/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَنْكَفَ (istankafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
